data: In the left plot, what is the approximate SARI score of the green line when the number of training examples is 450,000?

The green line represents the seq2seqBERT model. The x-axis shows the number of training examples, ranging from 450 to 4,500,000. The y-axis shows the SARI score, ranging from 0.1 to 0.9. At approximately 450,000 training examples, the green line reaches an SARI score of around 0.8. Therefore, the approximate SARI score of the green line when the number of training examples is 450,000 is 0.8.
